column1: CAN IDs, nodes and frame periods
125 kbit/s, 11-bit IDs, CANopen-like numbering. Only these 8 IDs appeared in 71,094 frames. Nothing on NMT 0x000, SYNC 0x080, EMCY or SDO.

Periods are differences between receipt timestamps of consecutive frames of one ID, excluding gaps over 1.5 periods (power-off, and frames missed by the sniffer in capture 2). p1 to p99 is the 1st to 99th percentile.

The stations run on a 150 ms grid, the actuators on 153.6 ms (a 2.4 % slower clock tick), so actuator frames drift through the station frames and no fixed phase exists between a lever change and the next actuator frame.
Drop connector (M12 A-coded): black CAN_H, blue CAN_L, brown 0 V, white +24 V, grey unused. 67 ohm between CAN_H and CAN_L with the EC4 off (two 120 ohm terminators in parallel, plus wiring).
